mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Strike Super restricted to Namekian CaCs. The user elongates the right arm; if the opponent is in range, the user pulls them in and strikes for a documented 10% damage, leaving the target stunned for follow-up attacks. Current exact-name documentation labels the acquisition generically as Skill Shop, while maintained archived shop evidence supports the more specific TP Medal Shop endpoint and a 30-TP-Medal listing; rotation timing is not inferred. For Orange Piccolo, the move functions as his Grab.
